name: Lamb Chops with Middle Eastern Cilantro Sauce (Chermoula) & Veggies

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small bunches cilantro
1 ½ lemons
6 medium carrots
6 medium zucchini squash

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic; transfer to a medium bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the garlic.
Juice lemons into the bowl. Add oil and spices; stir to combine the chermoula and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
1 ½ tsp paprika
½ tsp cayenne pepper
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and thinly slice carrots into ¼-inch thick rounds. Divide between two baking sheet pans.
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise; cut crosswise into ½-inch thick half-moons and add to the baking sheets with the carrots.
Drizzle veggies with oil and season with salt and pepper. Toss to combine and spread out in a single layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are fork-tender, 18-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the lamb chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 lamb loin chops
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add lamb chops and cook, flipping once, until cooked through, 5-6 minutes. Remove to a plate, cover loosely with aluminum foil, and rest 5 minutes.
To serve, divide lamb chops and roasted veggies between plates; drizzle with chermoula and enjoy!
